newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lung Kee hits new year high.
newsitem.headline: Lung Kee hits new year high.

text.p: Lung Kee Metal Holdings Ltd hit a new year high of US$0.91 in late afternoon trading on Wednesday.
Dealers said the stock is being bought by institutional investors as several broking houses, including DBS Securities, have called for a "buy" on the company.
At 0820 GMT, the stock was changing hands at US$0.905. Volume was an active 9.3 million shares.
"The stock started moving yesterday. Some funds are buying because several houses have called for a buy on the stock," said a dealer with a local broking firm.
An analyst from Kay Hian said the stock was still reasonably valued at current levels. "It is trading at 13 times 1997 earnings."
He said Kay Hian was also recommending a buy on Lung Kee Metal as the company has very good profit margins.
Lung Kee Metal, which makes mould bases and trades in metals, had offered 50 million shares in its Singapore public offer in January.
The company's parent is listed in Hong Kong.
